Hello, Mastodon! We are vibyverse, the ecosystem for computational chemistry.

Four open-source tools, one workflow:
vibe-sketcher: draw
vibe-scheduler: submit
vibe-qc: calculate
vibe-viewer: analyze
QVF connects them.

All of it is free, including the manuals, tutorials and educational material. A short thread on each.

https://vibyverse.com

#Introduction #Chemistry #CompChem #OpenSource
